asset_disposition.reason: The 15 authored data URIs live inside the extracted script.js in the source's own __LT_ASSETS map and are byte-identical there. The current-main validator does not require an assets/ directory, and the SRC071 precedent records self_contained with no assets/ directory. Decoding, re-encoding, externalizing, renaming or rewriting references was not performed and must not be, because it would change source bytes without a mechanical basis.

items.defect: 9 focusable elements, zero authored :focus and :focus-visible rules; focus is browser default outline:auto only.
Six hover-only affordances (.hero-stage lens, .dossier figure, .node, .flow-card, .btn, .topbar nav a) with no authored touch/press activation path on a coarse pointer.
.n5 / .n6 hidden at <=900px by the source's own media query.
.topbar nav hidden at <=900px, removing all 5 section anchors on mobile.

The source's reduced-motion media query kills CSS animation (computed animation-name:none), but the #pulseBtn pulse is a JavaScript Web Animation never gated on prefers-reduced-motion. One real click raises 2 Animation objects (.heart-core 700ms, .logo-close 900ms) and .heart-core visibly scales none -> 1.23041 -> 1.0398 under reduce.
items.s3_must_not: gate, rewrite or suppress this pulse

items.defect: .logo-close cannot be scrolled to its layout centre because it lies past the document scroll maximum.
scroll-behavior:smooth makes programmatic navigation asynchronous; a consumer assuming scrollTo is synchronous reads stale geometry. This invalidated one S2 capture run.

unresolved_observations.must_not: be converted into source truth, and must not be used to authorize a source change or a parity tolerance, without a separate proof (CENTRAL #589 comment 5859197749).
unresolved_observations.observation: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce at 1440x900@DPR1, document.getAnimations() reported 3 CSSAnimation objects against .hero-orbit (x2) and .radar whose reported currentTime advanced across the run (0 -> 33 -> 234 -> 367 -> 434), while getComputedStyle(...).animationName was 'none', element-scoped element.getAnimations() returned [] for those same elements, and CSSTransition counts of 0..7 were present on the same pages.
unresolved_observations.why_unresolved: Element-scoped getAnimations() being empty while document-scoped getAnimations() lists animations against the same targets is internally inconsistent. 700ms-separated clips of the orbit and radar regions were not pixel-identical, so residual visual change exists there, but it cannot be attributed to those named elements. The instrumentation cannot separate a browser bookkeeping artefact from real residual motion.
unresolved_observations.s3_action: recorded as unresolved metadata only; not resolved, not converted to source truth, not counted as a defect and not counted as a parity input
